# Buzzbee Beekeeping

> > Australian beekeeping supplies retailer offering Langstroth hives, queen rearing systems, honey extraction equipment, and native bee habitats from their Victoria warehouse.

Buzzbee Beekeeping is based in Bayswater North, Victoria, and specializes in commercial-grade beekeeping equipment including NICOT queen rearing kits, Flow hive components, stainless steel honey processing tanks, and native Australian mason hives. They serve beekeepers across Australia with premium hive components, queen breeding tools, and colony management supplies.

## Key Topics

- Langstroth hives
- Queen rearing systems
- NICOT queen breeding kits
- Flow hive components
- Stainless steel equipment
- Native Australian bees
- Mason hives
- Colony management
- Honey extraction
- Pest control (varroa, beetles)
- Commercial beekeeping
- Hive inspection tools
- Queen bee cages
- Victoria beekeeping supplies

## Regional Beekeeping Supplies

- [Beekeeping Supplies in Victoria | Buzzbee](https://buzzbee.com.au/pages/beekeeping-supplies-vic): Victoria beekeeping supplies hub featuring hives and extraction tools
